scientific_integrity: The proof separates prime powers from integers with at least two distinct prime factors, using the positive alternating tail after the two largest divisors and an Euler-product lower bound. A finite replay through \(200000\) is included only as regression evidence and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the fibers \(\Delta(n)\in\{0,1,2\}\) are classified. No classification of arbitrary higher fibers and no asymptotic statement for their counting functions is claimed.
title: Exact first three fibers of the alternating-divisor totient gap
